While in wild winds stance you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks.

findings.note: The +2 AC is against RANGED attacks only and StanceDef.acBonus is unconditional, so it is stated in `note` rather than applied to AC — an unconditional +2 would be a bigger error than the omission. The printed 30-foot ranged nature is carried by the strike's `range: 30` (StanceStrike gained that carrier in this batch) as well as being stated in the note; the create row therefore equals the shipped stances/wild-winds-stance record, and the gap-data-rows `strikes` field row on the same id is now identical and harmless. Inert until MainTab widens its stance source to stance-trait spells (CROSS-FILE GAPS).
